caveats.message: This campaign requires --mcp-config with at least one server; absent or empty catalogs are refused before spend. Connection statuses and the observed tool-surface identity are recorded per attempt.

notes: Report 4E. Startup metadata time (initMetadataMs) and the MCP server statuses are recorded per attempt so discovery cost is measured separately from model latency; the discovery cache is only defensible when tool availability and permissions are handled correctly.
